scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.focus: Modernize ordinary address and has; smooth the cargo-lightening purpose and the sequence of origin questions; render righteous blood as innocent blood in the sailors’ plea, keeping the blood image. Preserve Thou/hast/didst in their direct prayer, repeated Tarshish and from the Lord’s presence, equipment, sleeping/snoring, lot/calamity repetitions, servant of the Lord, worship, repeated surges, great fear, sacrifice and vows.

chapters.focus: Use attributive my for Jonah’s affliction and thanksgiving with praise.
